title: haplophyllum obtusifolium
intro: Haplophyllum obtusifolium, commonly known as Rock-spurge or Rock Broom, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to lower fever, treat scorpion stings, and provide relief from various skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis. The health benefits of Haplophyllum obtusifolium include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can be used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and diterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities.
